verdict.rationale: Cloudflare MoQ Relay is a managed media-streaming service with a dashboard and API, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only relay creation, token scoping, and QUIC-based streaming. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes are machine-readable docs for external tools, not AI-generated insights inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
